comments.text: VIC patterns $00-$7F, eight scanline bytes per character. The caves field uses these for cave rock, ledges and climbable ropes. The VIC sees bank 0 and charset offset $2800 on the playfield.
Patterns $80-$FF for the caves charset at $2800. The high-index patterns are selected by map bytes in the same way as the lower 128.
